metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at nothing and Valorant just said ‘Here, take it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get handed a kill for doing basically nothing?
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your aim takes days off but kills keep dropping.
Valorant logic is peak trolling again.

Tap if your aim’s on vacation but the kills don’t stop!
